Lets Child Lock use the volume buttons and keep your child in the app

While the lock is on, Child Lock uses this to notice the volume-button pattern, block the back button and swipes, close the notifications panel, and return to the app you handed over. While off, it only notices which app is open and whether a call or video is playing, so it can lock automatically. It never reads or stores what is on screen. (Where the optional “Skip ads” feature exists and is switched on, it reads button labels in the app you handed over, and nothing else.)

Child Lock uses Android’s accessibility feature as a parental lock, not as an accessibility aid.

While locked, it:
• Notices the volume-button pattern that unlocks
• Blocks the back button and home/back swipes
• Closes the notifications panel and returns to the app

While unlocked, it only notices which app is open, and whether a call or video is playing, for automatic locking.

It never reads, stores or sends what is on your screen.

(If this copy of Child Lock offers “Skip ads for them”, that one feature is off unless you turn it on, and when on it reads button labels in the app you handed over so it can tap “Skip ad”. The Play Store version does not include it.)

Locks by itself when a chosen app reaches its moment.

Add an app and choose its moment: a video call connecting, a video going full screen, anything playing, or simply opening. A short countdown gives you time to hand the phone over. Well-known apps get the right options by default.
Tap an app to add it. You choose when it locks next, and can change it any time.
Locks again if the same moment happens after you unlock.

After you unlock, Child Lock waits for the moment to end and happen again, for example the video leaving full screen and going back. It never re-locks while the same moment continues, and gives up on an app after three unlocks in a row until you leave it.
Taps “Skip ad” in the app while locked.

Only a “Skip ad” style button, never the ad itself and never “Skip intro”. To find the button it reads button labels in that one app while locked. Nothing is stored or sent. Most streaming services make their ads unskippable, so in practice this helps on YouTube and a few others.

Everything automatic: locking by itself when a call connects or a video goes full screen, locking again after you unlock, and skipping ads.\n\nThe lock itself, the volume buttons and every safety feature stay free, always.
These automatic extras are still being finished, so they are unlocked for now and nothing is for sale yet.\n\nThe lock itself, the volume buttons and every safety feature will always be free.

No dimming or sleep while locked.
The video stays put when the phone is tilted.
Back, the notifications panel and swipes do nothing while locked. Needs the Child Lock helper.
Home, back and recents. Android 11+, needs a volume unlock.

While locked the screen goes into the touch mode screen readers use, which is what stops Android acting on swipes from the edges. Touches still reach nothing. The touch backup to unlock in this mode is a three-finger triple tap, done twice within a few seconds. Off, a swipe shows the home screen for a moment and the app comes straight back.
Closes as soon as it is pulled down.
If the home screen appears, the app returns.
Stuck? Hold the power button for about 10 seconds to force a restart. Child Lock never survives a restart.
Hold the power button for about 10 seconds to force a restart. Child Lock never survives a restart, so the phone always comes back unlocked.
Open source. No ads, no accounts, nothing leaves your phone.
